abstract: The complete 13-class rational homology character of the 216-element automorphism group of the Pappus independence complex splits canonically into absolutely irreducible four- and six-dimensional modules, and two symmetry quotients are rationally acyclic.
integrity_notes: Exact finite enumeration and algebraic deduction; no independent mathematical validation or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Claims are rational only; no integral equivariant lattice, quotient homotopy type or proof of publication priority is asserted.
title: Two absolutely irreducible symmetry modules in Pappus independence homology
